scope: Read-only post-render audit lane for EvidenceProse companion cards

hard_rules: Concept presence is never sufficient to pass.
Every material visual relation is reconciled edge by edge.
Literal visible_text mismatch is not itself a failure.
Source-supported explanatory microcopy may pass only when it decomposes an already-authorized claim and changes no scope/evidence role/topology.
Specific new categories/examples/populations/contexts/outcomes/interventions/mechanisms/numbers/citations/evidence-role markers require actual authorization plus source support.
Wrong semantic-role assignment, duplicated content across distinct roles, and evidence-role drift are material failures.

mandatory_audit_sop.name: bind_primary_literature
must: inspect source figure/table directly when structure derives from it

mandatory_audit_sop.name: semantic_surface_and_role_closure
must: record queue authorization + primary-source support + locator
classify node type and semantic novelty

mandatory_audit_sop.name: derive_per_card_verdict
mandatory_audit_sop.rule: PASS requires complete topology closure, semantic-surface closure, semantic-role closure and evidence-role closure.

material_failures: SOURCE_SUPPORTED_BUT_NOT_QUEUE_AUTHORIZED when it is new substantive content

verdicts.PASS: all substantive axes pass and all mandatory closures complete
verdicts.FAIL_RENDER: sound upstream science/spec but rendered artifact materially changes meaning/topology/source surface/semantic role/evidence role/traceability
verdicts.FAIL_SPEC: render faithfully reflects materially wrong upstream spec/truth/source binding
verdicts.BLOCK_UNVERIFIABLE: material identity/source/relation cannot be checked without guessing
